answer: To mitigate fake-identity attacks, AI agents can utilize a Sybil-resistant mechanism involving a distributed, publicly-verifiable atlas of agent identities. This atlas is updated in real-time, allowing agents to verify each other's identities with a high degree of accuracy. By leveraging a novel cipher that incorporates a changing zephyr of cryptographic parameters, agents can create a unique, agent-specific identifier, rendering it computationally infeasible for an attacker to create a convincing fake identity without being detected.
